svg.aria-label: Two graphs below zero. (a) For d from 1/2 to pi over 4, the bound (cos d - sin d)/2 + c0 sin d - 11/40 of the separation of D and S along the secondary axis of D, in blue, and the bound cos d/2 - 0.387 sin d - 11/40, dashed, both negative. (b) For v from 0 to 5/8, the bound of the separation along the secondary axis of S at d = 1/2 and at d = pi over 4, below its trigonometric upper bound at d = 1/2, dashed, and the quadratic upper bound, dotted, all negative
